title: Blue beings appearing at Joe Dispenza's retreats and meditations

tellings.quote: Despensza says that in his uh you know deep meditations, blue beings show up in the room and they tell him that the the collective the people in the conference need to vibrate higher in order for the blue beings to fully manifest and heal

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on what Joe Dispenza, a man who runs large meditation retreats, says happens at them. According to Michels, Dispenza says that in his deep meditations blue beings show up in the room and tell him the people at the event need to "vibrate higher" so the beings can fully appear and heal them. If true, it would tie contact with other beings to the state of people's minds.
